  stack card gap 2

    draw width 104
      circle 42 stroke soft thick 10

      done "of" n "done today" head

        "All done. See you tomorrow." color good

        n - done "left for today" color muted

    stack card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      row gap 2
        stack grow gap 0
          h.name bold

        "This week" faint

        "of all ticks" faint

        "Last 30 days" faint

        "of all ticks" faint

    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.65

    "No habits yet" head
    "Add one small thing you can do even on a busy day, like reading two pages." color muted
else
  row gap 4 align center
    draw width 104
      circle 42 stroke soft thick 10
      arc 42, 0, 360 * clamp(done / n, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 10
      label 50, 50, done "/" n head
    stack grow gap 1
      done "of" n "done today" head
      if done >= n
        "All done. See you tomorrow." color good
      else
        n - done "left for today" color muted
  each habit as h
    stack card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      row gap 2
        stack grow gap 0
          h.name bold
          if streak(h.check) > 0
            streak(h.check) "day streak," round(count(h.check last 30 days) * 100 / 30) "% in 30 days" faint
          else
            "Not started yet. Tick it today." faint
        toggle h.check
      weekdots count(h.check on it) > 0
  stack card gap 3
    row gap 3
      stack gap 0
        "This week" faint
        round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Last 30 days" faint
        round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)) "%" head
        "of all ticks" faint
      stack gap 0
        "Best streak" faint
        plural(max(habit, streak(it.check)), "day") head
        "running now" faint
  row
    "Last 6 weeks" head grow
    "Average" round(count(check last 42 days) * 100 / (n * 42)) "%" faint
  grid 7 gap 0
    each 1..7
      dayname(today - 42 + it) tiny color muted align center
    each days last 42 days
      box height 44 pad 1 radius 8 stroke if(sel = it, ink, bg) thick 2 tap set sel = it
        box height 28 radius 6 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity if(count(check on it) > 0, clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1), 1)
        it "," count(check on it) "of" n "habits done" opacity 0
  row gap 1 align center
    "Less" faint
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill soft
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.3
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.65
    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent
    "More" faint
    space
    sel bold
    count(check on sel) "of" n "done" color muted

app "Savings" coin mint
table deposit amount money, note text?
setting goal money = 100000 "Savings goal"
state adding bool = no
state d new deposit
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let p = clamp(total / goal, 0, 1)
let mon(d date) = if(month(d) = 1, "jan", if(month(d) = 2, "Feb", if(month(d) = 3, "Mar", if(month(d) = 4, "Apr", if(month(d) = 5, "May", if(month(d) = 6, "Jun", "Jul"))))))
row gap 4 align center
  draw 40, 120 width 72
    rect 14, 6, 12, 92 fill soft radius 6
    rect 14, 98 - 92 * p, 12, 92 * p fill accent radius 6
    circle 20, 106, 12 fill accent
  stack grow gap 1
    "Saved so far" color muted
    total big
    round(p * 100) "% of" goal color muted tap edit goal
    if total >= goal
      "Goal reached" bold color good
    else
      text goal - total "to go" bold
"Add to savings" head
row gap 1
  button "+ 1,000" fill accent grow tap add deposit amount = 1000
  button "+ 5,000" grow tap add deposit amount = 5000
  button if(adding, "Close", "Other") grow tap set adding = not adding
if adding
  stack card gap 3
    field d
    button "Save deposit" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
section "Last 6 months", sum(deposit.amount month)
  plot 0..6, 0..max(1000, max([5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0], sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, 0 - it))) - 0.05 * 12 * 1000 / goal) axes gridlines
    each [5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0]
      rect index + 0.5, 0, 0.7, sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, 0 - it)) fill if(it = 0, accent, muted) radius 3
      tick index + 0.5, mon(addmonths(today, 0 - it))
  "Rupees saved each month; this month in colour" faint

each deposit sort at desc top 12 as r empty "Nothing saved yet. Tap +1,000 to make the first deposit."
  row card tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.note
      r.at faint
    r.amount bold
